HomeSections.practicalParkingValue: P2 car park at Place des Halles
HomeSections.experience1P1: Since 1998, Le R has set Strasbourg nights in motion and stands among the city's emblematic addresses. More than a club, it is a place to meet, celebrate and share, designed to offer every visitor an elegant, warm and memorable experience. Over the years, Le R has evolved while keeping what defines it: a unique atmosphere, attentive hospitality and an energy that brings people together.
HomeSections.experience1P2: Ideally located at 24 Place des Halles, in the heart of Strasbourg, the club is easy to reach from the city centre and the main districts of the metropolitan area. The Halles car park, just a few metres away, makes it simple to arrive and enjoy the night fully. This privileged setting makes Le R a natural meeting point for locals, students, young professionals and visitors passing through.
HomeSections.experience1ImageAlt: Façade of Le R at 24 Place des Halles, Strasbourg
HomeSections.experience2P1: Every weekend, Le R offers a festive programme led by its resident DJs and guest artists. Driving sets, animations, surprises and themed nights shape the evenings in an atmosphere where music, energy and the pleasure of being together become one. On the dance floor or around a drink, everything is in place to let go, dance and create unforgettable memories with friends.
HomeSections.experience2P2: Our teams also give particular care to the quality of service. Behind the bar, signature cocktails are prepared with attention, to accompany every moment of the night. For those who want a more exclusive experience, our VIP spaces offer a privileged setting, ideal for celebrating a birthday, marking a special occasion, or simply enjoying the night in exceptional conditions. Every reservation comes with personalised support so that each detail matches the group's wishes.
HomeSections.experience2ImageAlt: Live DJ set at Le R Strasbourg
HomeSections.experience3P1: Because a beautiful night should also be a peaceful one, our guests' well-being and safety remain at the centre of our priorities. Our welcome and security team watches over every event with professionalism, in a spirit of respect, kindness and conviviality. Everyone should be able to enjoy the atmosphere, reconnect and celebrate in a pleasant, secure environment.
HomeSections.experience3P2: Recognised for the quality of its welcome, its atmosphere and the diversity of its nights, Le R has become a true reference in Strasbourg nightlife. Loyal regulars, new faces and travellers gather around the same desire: to share an intense, elegant night full of emotion.
HomeSections.experience3ImageAlt: Interior atmosphere at Le R Strasbourg
HomeSections.experienceCloserP1: Whether you come for a night with friends, a birthday, a spontaneous outing or a VIP reservation, Le R welcomes you with the same attention. Here, every weekend tells a new story, every track brings people together, and every encounter can become a memory.
HomeSections.experienceCloserP2: Our ambition has remained the same from the beginning: to offer you a living, carefully crafted and authentic place, where everyone naturally finds their place, night after night, still today, in Strasbourg.
